# pvecli pool remove

Delete one or more resource pools.

```text
pvecli pool remove [POOLID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `POOLID` | Pool ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Delete even if pool has members (they are detached, not destroyed). |
